value.rationale: The family is a canonical graph-product family with a sharp girth-four obstruction to generic scale-two homotopy recovery; it exhibits n integral two-sphere classes created by the first Čech thickening while n quadrilateral H1 classes die. Both a complete homotopy classification and an exact filtration-induced kernel are structurally motivated, nontrivial information for an unbounded family.
